formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d₁ : Point) (d₂ : Point) (d₃ : Point) (AB : Line) (AC : Line) (D₁₂ : Line) (D₂₃ : Line), ((formRectilinearAngle a b c AB AC) ∧ (formRectilinearAngle d₁ d₂ d₃ D₁₂ D₂₃) ∧ ((∠ a:b:c : ℝ) > 0) ∧ ((∠ a:b:c : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟)) → (∃ (f : Point) (AF : Line), f.onLine AB ∨ f.onLine AC ∧ (∠ a:b:f : ℝ) = (∠ a:c:f : ℝ))

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (h : Point) (AB : Line) (AC : Line), ((formRectilinearAngle a b c AB AC) ∧ ((∠ a:b:c : ℝ) > 0) ∧ ((∠ a:b:c : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟) ∧ (a ≠ h ∧ b ≠ h ∧ c ≠ h)) → (∃ l : Point, (∠ c:l:b : ℝ) = (∠ a:b:c) / 2 ∧ (∠ a:l:b : ℝ) = (∠ a:b:c) / 2)
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c h : Point) (AB AC : Line) (h1 : formRectilinearAngle a b c AB AC) (h3 : (∠ a:b:c : ℝ) > 0) (h4 : (∠ a:b:c : ℝ) < ∟ + ∟) (h' : a ≠ h ∧ b ≠ h ∧ c ≠ h) : ∃ l : Point, (∠ c:l:b : ℝ) = (∠ a:b:c) / 2 ∧ (∠ a:l:b : ℝ) = (∠ a:b:c) / 2 := by

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c : Point) (AB AC : Line), formRectilinearAngle b a c AB AC ∧ AB ≠ AC → ∃ f : Point, f ≠ a ∧ (∠ b:a:f = ∠ c:a:f)
nl_statement: To cut a given rectilinear angle in half. Let $BAC$ be the given rectilinear angle. So it is required to cut it in half.    <prf>  Thus, angle $DAF$ is equal to angle $EAF$ [Prop.~1.8]. Thus, the given rectilinear angle $BAC$ has been cut in half by the straight-line $AF$.
